faqs.q: How is IDFC FIRST Select credit card?
faqs.a: IDFC FIRST Select credit card is a good choice for beginners seeking a lifetime free credit card with reward benefits. High spenders and frequent travellers can also maximise their value-back through uncapped rewards, along with higher savings and discounts on travel, dining and movie spends.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the IDFC FIRST Wealth credit card and the FIRST Select credit card?
faqs.a: Among IDFC FIRST Select and IDFC Wealth, the latter is a premium variant based on the features and benefits. While both cards are lifetime free, Wealth comes with a higher income eligibility requirement of Rs. 36 Lakh per annum, in comparison to Rs. 12 Lakh per annum on Select. Wealth also offers a lower forex markup fee, a better reward rate, and other lifestyle benefits.

faqs.q: What is the forex markup fee for IDFC FIRST Select credit card?
faqs.a: The forex mark-up fee charged to the IDFC FIRST Select credit card users is 1.99%.

faqs.q: Does Select credit card have a movie offer?
faqs.a: Yes, IDFC FIRST Select credit card offers buy 1 and get up to Rs. 125 off offer on the 2nd movie ticket on District twice a month on spending min. Rs. 20,000 in the previous month.

faqs.q: How to apply for an IDFC FIRST Select credit card?
faqs.a: If interested, you can apply for an IDFC FIRST Select credit card by visiting the bank’s official website or contacting the customer care.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for IDFC Select credit card?
faqs.a: Individuals who earn an annual income of more than Rs. 12 Lakh can apply for this card.

faqs.q: Does IDFC Bank FIRST Select Credit Card offer lounge access?
faqs.a: Yes, IDFC FIRST Select credit card offers both railway and airport lounge access. Cardholders can access 4 complimentary railway lounge visits per quarter and 1 domestic airport lounge visit per quarter. But these lounge visits are subject to monthly spends of Rs. 20,000.

faqs.q: Is there an expiry date on the reward points accrued on my card?
faqs.a: The reward points earned using your IDFC FIRST Select Credit Card expire after 24 months.
